evidence.label: Statistical guess by a closed model
evidence.reliability: A probability from a commercial classifier. Not independently reproducible; it can be wrong, and new generators are often missed.

not_checked.name: Google SynthID / Meta / TikTok invisible watermarks
not_checked.why: No public detector exists. Use the vendor's own verification tool where one is offered.

not_checked.name: Generator-specific model fingerprints (spectral/architecture traces)
not_checked.why: No validated open detector is bundled; the only model-specific signal used is Hive's source classifier, when Hive ran.

not_checked.name: Prompt / account / usage records
not_checked.why: Held by the generator's provider; obtainable only through a lawful request.

cautions: Only a single statistical signal supports this. Treat it as a pointer for further checks, not as a finding.
A generator family is a lead about HOW the media was made. It does not show who made it or who posted it.
No watermark, metadata or classifier hit does not mean the media is real: most generators sign nothing and every platform strips metadata.
next_steps: Find the earliest copy of this media (Where it appeared): provenance data survives best there.
If the signal is only declared, test it: re-generate with the stated model/seed where the model is available.
Ask the generator's provider (through the police) whether the media was created on their service.

signed.label: Cryptographically signed
signed.meaning: Proves who signed the record and that the file is unchanged since. The signer's statements are only as honest as the signer.

declared.label: Written in the file
declared.meaning: Natural photos almost never carry this, but anyone can add, copy or remove it.

watermark.label: Decoded invisible watermark
watermark.meaning: Fragile (resizing and compression destroy it) and the public reference payload can be embedded by anyone.

classifier.label: Statistical guess by a closed model
classifier.meaning: A probability from a commercial classifier. Not independently reproducible; it can be wrong, and new generators are often missed.

inherited.label: Found on another verified copy
inherited.meaning: An earlier copy of the same media carried this signal before it was stripped. Rests on the copy match being right.
